name: Zen'aku
source:
The protagonist has captured 4 women and confines them to an abandoned hospital in order to expose and condemn the crimes that they committed.

These women are deeply involved in the deaths of his beloved younger brother and sister. However, they won't break so easily.

If they don't want to be upfront, then he will get the information out of them. Interrogation, torture... using any means possible to punish them thoroughly.

[Translated from [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/72zenaku/]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角抓住了4名女性，将她们关押在一所废弃医院里，以揭露并惩罚她们犯下的罪行。

这些女人与他心爱的弟弟和妹妹之死有着深切关系。然而，她们并不会轻易屈服。

既然不愿主动交代，他就要从她们口中逼出情报。审讯、拷问……不择手段地彻底惩罚她们。

（译自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/72zenaku/]官方网站[/url]）
